title: cloud signal
description: How much of each cloud-synced folder (OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud-style File Provider folders under ~/Library/CloudStorage, or providers.cloud.folders) is really stored on this Mac. Walks the folders with lstat (never triggers downloads) every providers.cloud.interval_minutes. GET /api/signals/cloud, polled every 2 min; 404 unless providers.cloud.enabled; null until the first walk. SENSITIVE (folder / account names).

name.description: Display name ('OneDrive · Example' for 'OneDrive-Example' style folders).

used.description: Bytes allocated on this Mac (online-only placeholders count 0).

partial.description: The walk hit its 120 s deadline; numbers are lower bounds.

warn_bytes.description: providers.cloud.warn_gb in bytes: widgets warn above this.

disk_free.description: Free space on the startup volume, bytes, or null.

at.description: When the walk finished. Unix time in seconds (float).
